03 / case studies

Work that moved needles.

Eight snapshots across healthcare, real estate, SaaS, events, consumer tech and food. Each one shows what I wrote and what the writing was designed to do.

Selected work01 of 08
Healthcare · Medical

Faith Health Group & KiviCare

Faith Home Healthcare · Faith Hospice · Faith Day Habilitation · KiviCare EHR

Healthcare content is a world where every word carries weight. I learned the medical terminology, the insurance policies, and how families actually make decisions about a loved one's care, then wrote copy that connected hearts to healing.

  • Website copy turning anxious families into confident care seekers
  • Blog posts ranking #1 for “home healthcare services” and staying there
  • Email campaigns with 35%+ open rates vs 21% industry average
  • Ad copy that reduced cost-per-lead by 40% while maintaining quality
Real Estate · Property

No Brokerage Hub & Arham Promoters

No Brokerage Hub · Arham Promoters · Ahmedabad

Wrote every word that made No Brokerage Hub sound trustworthy in a fiercely competitive industry. Built their entire brand voice, from the ‘Why pay brokers when you have NBH?’ website copy to Instagram posts that actually brought property seekers through the door.

  • Blog posts ranking #1 for “real estate investment Ahmedabad”
  • Property brochures that sold units before the first site visit
  • Social content converting 40% of units in pre-booking from socials
  • Full social media calendar, strategy & GMB content
IT & Software Consulting

HyfunTech Technologies

HyfunTech · Web Development & Software Consulting

Web development content meant balancing technical capability with business results. I wrote blogs that connected code to cash flow: content that turned website visitors into project partners and tire-kickers into paying clients.

  • Blog posts ranking for “web development services” with sustained visibility
  • B2B long-form blogs, social media content calendar, and case studies
  • High-value images for blogs, case studies, and key content endpoints
  • Case studies that helped prospects see their own digital success
Events & Marketing · B2B

Odoo Community Days 2023

Odoo · Tech Conference · End-to-End Event Marketing

Handed a blank slate and a deadline, I wrote end-to-end content for one of the biggest Odoo community events. Banners, brochures, campaigns, website, social media: every piece of marketing in one consistent voice, because first impressions don't get a sequel.

  • Event brochures that gave attendees a reason to actually read them
  • Banner and campaign copy that stopped scrolls and filled seats
  • Website content that made registration feel like a no-brainer
  • End-to-end marketing collateral in one voice, across every touchpoint
Consumer Tech · On-Demand Services

Urban Company (Formerly Urban Clap)

Urban Company · App Push Notifications · English, Hindi & Gujarati

Push notifications are the hardest content to get right: under 10 seconds, no second chance. I wrote app notifications in three languages, English, Hindi, and Gujarati, each one built to feel native, not translated. The goal was never just delivery. It was the tap.

  • App notifications in English, Hindi & Gujarati written to feel genuinely local
  • Copy calibrated for tap-through rate, not just impressions
  • Regional language content that matched voice and cultural context
  • Consistent brand tone across three language contexts simultaneously
Food & Retail · eCommerce

Food Voyageur

Food Voyageur · Custom Cakes · Melbourne, Australia

Artisan baking content meant understanding why people pay premium prices for handmade cakes. I spent weeks studying food photography and flavour design, then wrote everything that made mouths water and wallets open.

  • Blog posts ranking #1 for “custom cakes Melbourne” driving consistent orders
  • Social media content making followers crave and order custom creations
  • Product descriptions justifying premium pricing through craftsmanship stories
  • Website copy that turned Instagram scrollers into cake customers
Food & Catering · B2B

PlantRich Catering

PlantRich Catering · Plant-Based Events · Melbourne

At PlantRich Catering, I learned vegan nutrition, event planning logistics, and why businesses choose plant-based for their events. Then I wrote content that made plant-based food sound exciting instead of virtuous.

  • 100+ product descriptions turning skeptical planners into plant-based advocates
  • 20+ collection & landing pages and eCommerce collection pages
  • Website ranking for “catering Melbourne” generating consistent bookings
  • Catering descriptions that made plant-based options sound genuinely gourmet
